title: Calculus based mechanics and lab preparation
purpose: Model motion with Newton laws and conservation laws, and estimate uncertainty in simple measurements.

blocks.deliverable: Estimate errors and plot a measured or supplied trajectory.
Draw free body diagrams before writing equations.
Solve collisions and compare conserved quantities.
Week 7 midterm; analyze a rotating system.
Derive a simple orbital or oscillator relation.
Collect safe motion data and assess the model residuals.
Report raw data and uncertainty; complete the mechanics final.

project: Measure a pendulum or rolling motion, fit a model and explain limitations and uncertainty.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
